orientation.note_en: A woodland path runs west-east across the lower middle of the map; the great oak with the door stands on the north side of the path, its door facing south onto the path; the low sun-shaft comes from the west (left). Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot along the path from the west, the low sun-shaft slanting past between tall trunks onto the little door in the great oak
eye-level wide shot along the path from the east into the low sun, the great oak with the door in silhouette beside the path
eye-level medium shot straight across the path at the horseshoe-arched door set into the fluted trunk, its carved limestone frame and roundel
low-angle close shot from the threshold stone up at the studded door standing a hand's width ajar on darkness
eye-level wide shot from the doorway looking out across the path into the dim wood
high oblique medium shot from among the western trunks down across ferns to the huge oak and its roots
eye-level medium shot from beside the door along the path eastward into deep green shade
high oblique close shot from the eastern trunks onto the half-buried threshold stone and leaf litter in the pool of sun
low-angle detail shot at ground level across the leaf litter and ferns to the threshold stone and the foot of the door

checklist.note_en: trees drawn as sawn-off stumps (the living veteran oak reads as a felled stump); a stray dark pipe-like object on the path east of the door; a stained-glass mosaic disc lying on the ground top-left; kept for H2
